reply_text:
I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes and sent you the list in our DM.

1. **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (2025-10-05). Thea Ramaswell logged it on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers at Dock Doors 14–18 in the Eau Claire yard weren't getting their SMS bay assignments from the gatehouse kiosk. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that the fix held. There's still a to-do to archive the kiosk logs before the 14 Oct maintenance window.
2. **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)". Thea also logged this one: on third shift, the gatehouse scanners at Door 14 weren't reading trailer tags. It was escalated to tier-2 support to test the scanner firmware.

**What I checked:** all six of Moss's notes in the shared files. All of them are public. His 14 Sep 2025 pipeline digest and 23 Mar 2026 renewal check-in both mention Quarrendon but give no ticket number. The Central team notes list #4409, #4412 and FR-882, but those are for the Marrow accounts, not Quarrendon. The cheat sheet also says not to confuse Quarrendon Freight Lines with Quarendon Freightways, a different company that isn't a customer. I also looked at #general and #help-it-ops, the two channels that both you and Moss are in. Neither has any messages.

**Before you use them:** the two numbers are written in different formats (only one starts with "PD-"), and the cheat sheet has no date. It's worth checking both in the ticket system before they go in the weekly notes.
